But its construction for Φ_q ∤ A (section 4.1, Proposition 12) is the one of section 2 of the note, which `proof.md` does not prove again (the note's section 3 says so, and the paper's own box credits it to the searching instance). A reader of the note should also be told that the paper's lower bound for Φ_q ∤ A is not section 2's induction. "Twelve pages": yes. "Refereed in two readings": yes, `referee.md` and `referee-2.md`, the same instance; the paper says of itself that two of its sentences are later than the second reading.
